description: Composite skill combining account balances, upcoming bills, and recent transactions

system_context.engine_import: from engine.base import SkillBase, SkillRequest, SkillResponse

mandatory_patterns.no_database: Composite. No _get_conn, no psycopg2. Uses importlib.
mandatory_patterns.import_pattern: importlib.import_module then getattr then await cls().run(request)
mandatory_patterns.skillresponse_signature: SkillResponse ONLY accepts: skill_name, data, summary, confidence, sources, error.

build_plan.instruction:
Write file skeleton. Imports: logging, importlib, engine.base. Class FinancialOverviewSkill with name='financial_overview', triggers=['financial overview', 'money overview', 'full finance', 'how are my finances', 'financial status', 'finance report']. Define SUB_SKILLS:

SUB_SKILLS = {
    'balances': ('data.finance_balance', 'FinanceBalanceSkill'),
    'bills': ('data.query_bills_due', 'QueryBillsDueSkill'),
    'transactions': ('data.query_transactions', 'QueryTransactionsSkill'),
}

Methods: execute, _run_skill, _build_overview. All 'pass'. ASCII only.

Implement _run_skill (same pattern as daily_briefing: importlib, getattr, await run, try/except). Implement _build_overview: collect summaries from ok responses in order [balances, bills, transactions], join with ' | '. Default: 'No financial data available.' Return string.

Implement execute(). Run all three sub-skills. Build overview. Merge data. Return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data=merged, summary=overview, confidence=0.9, sources=['financial_overview']). try/except.
Review. No database imports. All three sub-skills referenced correctly. Summary never empty. ASCII only. Production-ready.
